mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( account_id, category, event_key, title, message, channels, in_app, created_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{category}, #{eventKey}, #{title}, #{message}, #{channels}, #{inApp}, #{createdAt} ) ON CONFLICT (event_key) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO notification_delivery ( notification_id, channel, status, detail ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{detail} ) ON CONFLICT (notification_id, channel) DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT notification_id, account_id, category, title, message, channels, created_at, read_at FROM notification
ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND in_app AND read_at IS NULL

SELECT d.delivery_id, d.notification_id, d.attempts, n.title, n.message, c.email AS recipient FROM notification_delivery d JOIN notification n ON n.notification_id = d.notification_id LEFT JOIN account c ON c.account_id = n.account_id WHERE d.channel = 'EMAIL' AND d.status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY d.created_at ASC, d.delivery_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_delivery SET status = #{status}, detail = #{detail}, attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId}
mapper.select: SELECT email FROM account WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND email IS NOT NULL
